title: Multipart form with more than 10 parts rejected with HTTP 413 (MaxUploadSizeExceededException) on Spring Boot 4.0.x

sources.license: Facts summarized from a public GitHub issue/PR; short error excerpt quoted.

symptom: A multipart/form-data request with 11 or more parts is rejected before it reaches the controller: the client gets 413 and the server logs MaxUploadSizeExceededException: Maximum upload size exceeded. The same form worked on Spring Boot 3.5.
cause: In Spring Boot 4.0.x the default of server.tomcat.max-part-count is 10 (an old Tomcat default), while Tomcat itself and Boot 3.5.x use 50. Requests with more parts than the limit are refused regardless of their size.
fixSummary: Set server.tomcat.max-part-count to at least the number of parts a request can contain (for example 50) in application.properties. Upgrading to Spring Boot 4.0.4, which realigns the default, also fixes it.
